reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Mark registration application requirements and contents
headings.reviewNote: Sets mark registration application filing requirements with secretary of state, applicant details, goods classes, and ownership statement.

headings.title: Application execution and verification
headings.reviewNote: Requires application signature and verification by applicant, firm member, or corporate officer.

headings.title: Specimen or facsimile submission in triplicate
headings.reviewNote: Mandates submission of specimens or facsimiles of mark in triplicate with registration application.

headings.title: Application fee payable to revenue director
headings.reviewNote: Requires payment of fifty-dollar registration fee payable to director of revenue.

headings.title: Disclosure of federal trademark applications
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes secretary of state to require statement and details of federal trademark filings and refusal reasons.

headings.title: Mark drawing requirements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes secretary of state to require compliance drawing of mark with application.

headings.title: Examination of application for statutory conformity
headings.reviewNote: Provides for examination of registration application for conformity with sections 417.005 to 417.066.

headings.title: Additional information and application amendments
headings.reviewNote: Requires applicant to provide additional requested information and permits amendments in response to rejections.

headings.title: Disclaimer of unregisterable mark components
headings.reviewNote: Governs mandatory or voluntary disclaimers of unregisterable matter without prejudice to common law or future rights.

headings.title: Manner of making application amendments
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes agreed amendments on submitted application or requiring fresh application.

headings.title: Notice of refusal, response period, and abandonment
headings.reviewNote: Governs notification of refusal, applicant reply period, reexamination, and abandonment upon failure to respond.

headings.title: Judicial review of registration refusal
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Cole County circuit court extraordinary writ action to compel mark registration without costs against secretary of state.

headings.title: Concurrent applications for confusingly similar marks
headings.reviewNote: Directs secretary of state to grant registration to first filer among concurrent applications for confusingly similar marks.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all thirteen subsections and 1973/1995 history note; confirmed mark application contents, verification, triplicate specimens, $50 fee, examination, disclaimers, refusal/abandonment, Cole County writ review, and filing-order priority.

headings.title: Certificate of registration issuance and contents
headings.reviewNote: Directs secretary of state to issue and deliver certificate of mark registration with statutory particulars.

headings.title: Evidentiary effect of registration certificate
headings.reviewNote: Establishes certificate or certified copy as competent and sufficient proof of mark registration.

headings.title: Duplicate certificate application and fee
headings.reviewNote: Entitles a registrant to receive a duplicate certificate upon application and payment of a ten-dollar fee.

headings.title: Abstract of mark application and fee
headings.reviewNote: Entitles a registrant to receive an abstract of a mark upon application and payment of a five-dollar fee.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 1973/1995 history note; retained titles and aligned subsections 3–4 notes with mandatory 'shall receive' entitlement for $10 duplicates and $5 abstracts.

headings.title: Ten-year registration term and renewal
headings.reviewNote: Establishes ten-year registration term and six-month pre-expiration renewal window with ten-dollar renewal fee payable to director of revenue.

headings.title: Pre-expiration notification by secretary of state
headings.reviewNote: Requires secretary of state to notify registrants of renewal requirement within year preceding expiration.

headings.title: Expiration of existing registrations
headings.reviewNote: Governs expiration of registrations in force on September 28, 1973, within ten years or by September 28, 1974.

headings.title: Renewal application statement of continued use
headings.reviewNote: Requires renewal applications to include statement that mark is still in use in state.

headings.title: Initial notice to previous registrants
headings.reviewNote: Required notification within six months of September 28, 1973, to registrants under prior acts.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all five subsections and 1973/1995 history note; retained titles and corrected subsection 1 note from $50 to the statutory $10 renewal fee.

headings.title: Assignment with business goodwill and recording
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes assignment of mark with goodwill, writing and recording requirements, and voidness against subsequent purchasers without notice.

headings.title: Change of name recording and new certificates
headings.reviewNote: Provides for recording certificate of change of name and issuing new certificate of registration in assignee's name.

headings.title: Evidentiary effect of acknowledgment and recording
headings.reviewNote: Establishes acknowledgment and recording as prima facie evidence of instrument execution.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1973/1995 history note; confirmed goodwill assignment ($50 fee, 3-month recording window), name-change recording, and prima facie acknowledgment/recording evidence.

headings.title: Classification system purpose and single-class limit
headings.reviewNote: Establishes administrative goods and services classes and restricts single application to single class.

headings.title: Enumeration of goods and services classes
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates 34 classes of goods and 8 classes of services for mark registration.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections (including all 34 goods classes and 8 services classes) and 1973/1995 history note; confirmed single-class application limit and classification headings.

headings.title: Injunctive relief for reputation injury or dilution
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes injunctive relief for likelihood of injury to business reputation or mark dilution regardless of competition or confusion.

headings.title: Injunction, damages, and destruction of counterfeits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes suits to enjoin counterfeits or imitations, profits and damages recovery, and destruction of infringing goods.

headings.title: Preservation of criminal prosecutions
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that civil remedies do not affect rights to prosecute under penal laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections, 1973/1995 history, and 1998 8th Cir. annotation (Viacom Inc. v. Ingram Enterprises, Inc., 141 F.3d 886) on federal registration defense vs non-preemption; confirmed all headings.

headings.title: Preservation of common law mark rights
headings.reviewNote: Preserves rights and enforcement of marks acquired in good faith at common law.

headings.title: Jurisdiction and procedure for cancellation and compelling registration
headings.reviewNote: Governs court jurisdiction for mark cancellation and Cole County circuit court jurisdiction for extraordinary writs.

headings.title: Service of process on nonresident registrants
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes service of process on nonresident registrants through corporate service procedures under section 351.594.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1973–2007 history note; confirmed common-law mark preservation, cancellation vs Cole County extraordinary-writ venue, and § 351.594 nonresident service.

headings.title: Flour and meal brand filing with recorder of deeds
headings.reviewNote: Requires flour and meal manufacturers to file acknowledged brand facsimile with county recorder of deeds before manufacturing.

headings.title: Exclusive brand trademark claim and federal rights reservation
headings.reviewNote: Protects recorded brand trademark claims and preserves rights under federal copyright and patent laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1909–1939 revision history; confirmed flour/grits/hominy/meal brand facsimile recording with county recorder and exclusive brand trademark claim with federal patent/copyright reservation.

headings.title: Unauthorized use of fraternal or organizational names prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits assuming or using deceptive or colorable imitations of military, benevolent, or fraternal organization names.

headings.title: Priority and exclusive right based on earliest organization
headings.reviewNote: Accords prior and exclusive name rights to organization first organized and incorporated under state or federal law.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1919–1939 revision history; confirmed bar on unauthorized use of military/benevolent/fraternal organization names and earliest-organization priority.

headings.title: Application and fee for registration of organizational emblem
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes application, emblem submission, and fifty-dollar fee for registering organizational name and insignia.

headings.title: Issuance of registration certificate
headings.reviewNote: Directs secretary of state to issue attested certificate of registration upon statutory compliance.

headings.title: Evidentiary effect of registration certificate
headings.reviewNote: Establishes certificate as sufficient proof of emblem adoption and lawful right to wear or display insignia.

headings.title: Ancillary fees for emblem assignments and duplicates
headings.reviewNote: Establishes fees for emblem assignments, renewals, duplicate certificates, and abstracts matching trademark fees.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 1919–1995 history note; confirmed $50 organizational emblem registration, attested certificate issuance, evidentiary proof, and trademark-matched ancillary fees.

headings.title: Five-year registration term and renewal
headings.reviewNote: Establishes five-year emblem registration term and six-month pre-expiration renewal window with twenty-five dollar fee.

headings.title: Renewal statement of continued emblem use
headings.reviewNote: Requires emblem renewal applications to state that emblem is still in use in state.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1995 enactment note; confirmed 5-year emblem term, $25 renewal fee within 6 months, and continued-use statement requirement.

headings.title: Mandatory fictitious name registration and false declaration penalties
headings.reviewNote: Requires fictitious-name registration within five days under section 575.060 false declaration penalties; source notes flag 'shall' (*) and 'and' (**) in original rolls.

headings.title: Misleading and governmental agency names prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits fictitious names indicating governmental agency status or containing seriously misleading words.

headings.title: Required registration statement contents
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required registration contents including fictitious name, physical address, and owner details.

headings.title: Cancellation and reregistration upon change of interest
headings.reviewNote: Requires cancellation filing within five days of business cessation or ownership change, permitting new registration.

headings.title: Disclosure of exact ownership interests for limited liability
headings.reviewNote: Mandates exact ownership disclosure if owner claims non-joint liability and keeps disclosure optional for others.

headings.title: Exemption for licensed profession partnerships
headings.reviewNote: Exempts entities formed for practice of licensed profession from fictitious name business conduct requirements.

headings.title: Five-year active term and expiration for post-2004 filings
headings.reviewNote: Establishes five-year active duration and expiration for fictitious name registrations filed on or after August 28, 2004.

headings.title: Five-year term for pre-2004 registrations
headings.reviewNote: Subjects active registrations filed prior to August 28, 2004, to five-year expiration unless renewed.

headings.title: Renewal filing requirements and timing
headings.reviewNote: Specifies renewal timing within six months of expiration and required renewal details.

headings.title: Duration of renewed registration
headings.reviewNote: Provides that renewal continues effective registration for five years from scheduled expiration date.

headings.title: Inactivation of unrenewed pre-2004 registrations
headings.reviewNote: Directs secretary of state to inactivate unrenewed pre-August 28, 2004 registrations on or after August 28, 2009.

headings.title: Removal of inactive, withdrawn, or cancelled records
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes secretary of state to remove withdrawn, cancelled, or expired registrations from active records.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all twelve subsections and source notes; confirmed fictitious-name registration, cancellation, ownership disclosure, licensed-profession exemption, 5-year term/renewal, and documented original-rolls footnotes ('shall' and 'and') in subsection 1.

headings.title: Fictitious name registration and renewal fee
headings.reviewNote: Imposes two-dollar fee payable to director of revenue for electronic or written registration or renewal.

headings.title: Fee waiver for active duty military and National Guard
headings.reviewNote: Waives registration fee for Missouri resident members of Missouri National Guard or active duty military.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1919–2014 history note; confirmed $2 registration/renewal fee and fee waiver for Missouri-resident active duty military and Missouri National Guard members.

headings.title: Record book and certified copy as evidence
headings.reviewNote: Requires recorder of deeds and secretary of state to keep indexed record book and makes certified copy competent evidence.

headings.title: Fees for filing and certified copies
headings.reviewNote: Establishes three-dollar filing fee and five-dollar certified copy fee for recorders of deeds and secretary of state.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1919–1939 revision history; confirmed indexed record book / certified-copy evidence and $3 filing / $5 certified-copy fees.

headings.title: Dairy receptacle mark description and publication
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes dairy manufacturers to file mark description with secretary of state and publish notice in county newspaper.

headings.title: Secretary of state certificate issuance and fee
headings.reviewNote: Directs secretary of state to issue attested certificate of record upon payment of statutory fee.

headings.title: Certificate as prima facie evidence in prosecutions
headings.reviewNote: Establishes certificate as prima facie evidence of mark adoption, ownership, and right of use in prosecutions.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1919–1939 revision history; confirmed dairy-receptacle mark filing and 3-week newspaper publication, attested certificate issuance, and prima facie evidentiary status.

headings.title: Required contract cover sheet and statutory disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Mandates conspicuous cover sheet setting forth developer contact details and bold statutory consumer rights warnings.

headings.title: Restriction to mandatory disclosure contents
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits cover notice from containing matter beyond information required by subsection 1.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections (including mandatory 10-point bold invention-developer cover-sheet warnings) and 1995 enactment note; confirmed cover-sheet contents and no-additional-matter restriction.

headings.title: Surety bond requirement for prior decree or judgment
headings.reviewNote: Requires twenty-five thousand dollar surety bond for invention developers subject to prior decree or judgment.

headings.title: Cash deposit alternative in lieu of surety bond
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes cash deposit with director of economic development as alternative to surety bond.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1995 enactment note; confirmed $25,000 surety bond requirement for developers with prior fraud/deception decrees and four cash-deposit alternatives.

headings.title: Restriction on negotiable instruments other than checks
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits invention developer from accepting negotiable instruments other than checks for services.

headings.title: Prohibition of promissory notes cutting off defenses
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits notes or drafts that would cut off third-party defenses against developer upon negotiation.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1995 enactment note; confirmed prohibition on negotiable instruments other than checks (denying holder-in-due-course status) and bar on defense-cutting notes or drafts.

headings.title: Unenforceability of noncompliant contracts
headings.reviewNote: Declares invention development contracts failing to comply with sections 417.400 to 417.436 unenforceable against customer.

headings.title: Voidability of contracts procured by fraud or deception
headings.reviewNote: Declares contracts entered into through fraud, false pretense, or fraudulent omission void and unenforceable.

headings.title: Ineffectiveness of customer waivers
headings.reviewNote: Invalidates customer waivers of statutory protections except express confidentiality waivers under section 417.427.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1995 enactment note; confirmed unenforceability of noncompliant contracts (with bona fide error exception), fraud-procured unenforceability, and void customer waivers except § 417.427(2).

headings.title: Customer civil action for double damages, fees, and punitive awards
headings.reviewNote: Imposes civil liability for at least twice sustained damages (presumed at least all moneys paid), costs, reasonable attorney's fees, and discretionary punitive damages for malice.

headings.title: Voidability of contract for failure to make disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Renders contract entered into without required statutory disclosures voidable by customer.

headings.title: Attorney general enforcement and civil penalties
headings.reviewNote: Empowers attorney general to enforce provisions, recover civil penalties, and seek equitable relief.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1995 enactment note; updated subsection 1 title and note to reflect double damages (presumed at least all moneys paid), fees, and discretionary punitive damages for malice.

headings.title: Confidentiality duty and customer disclosure exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Imposes duty of confidentiality on invention developer regarding customer disclosures and enumerates public domain exceptions.

headings.title: Reasonable security measures and written waiver requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires reasonable security steps to protect disclosures and restricts waivers to express written agreements after disclosures.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1995 enactment note; confirmed invention-developer confidentiality duty with four exceptions and express written post-disclosure waiver requirement.

headings.title: Injunctive relief for actual or threatened trade secret misappropriation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes injunctions against misappropriation, termination upon trade secret cessation, and commercial advantage extensions.

headings.title: Royalty conditioning in exceptional circumstances
headings.reviewNote: Permits conditioned future use upon reasonable royalty in exceptional circumstances where prohibitive injunction is inequitable.

headings.title: Compelled affirmative protective acts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court orders compelling affirmative acts to protect trade secrets in appropriate circumstances.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1995 enactment note; confirmed trade secret misappropriation injunctions, exceptional-circumstance royalties, and compelled affirmative protective acts.

headings.title: Damages for actual loss, unjust enrichment, or reasonable royalty
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes damages for actual loss, unjust enrichment, or reasonable royalty for trade secret misappropriation.

headings.title: Punitive damages for outrageous misappropriation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes punitive damages award where trade secret misappropriation involves evil motive or reckless indifference.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1995 enactment note; confirmed actual loss/unjust enrichment/reasonable royalty damages and punitive damages for outrageous misappropriation.

headings.title: Displacement of conflicting civil tort and restitutionary remedies
headings.reviewNote: Displaces conflicting tort, restitutionary, and other civil laws providing remedies for trade secret misappropriation.

headings.title: Non-displacement of contractual, criminal, and other claims
headings.reviewNote: Preserves contractual, other non-trade-secret civil, criminal, and general litigation discovery rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1995 enactment note; confirmed displacement of conflicting civil trade-secret remedies and preservation of contract, non-trade-secret civil, criminal, and general discovery rights.
